etienne.dating: Romanesque features explicitly coloured in figure 4. Pale-yellow XIII-century extension and grey later elements excluded; contemporary background used for alignment only.
etienne.method: Similarity fit to two ends of the surviving cathedral; two separate cathedral corner checks on IGN Plan v2. Checks do not validate the complete historical quarter.

castle.dating: Late twelfth century, figure 11; uncertain gate and possible accesses retain their labels.
castle.method: Approximate placement from the figure 6 castle symbol, north arrow and printed 50-metre scale. No independent survey check; symbol centre does not establish an archaeological footprint.
castle.positionalAccuracy: Unvalidated approximate placement; no measured accuracy claim.

pierre.dating: Retain red phases circa 1100 and 1150 and light-green phase circa 1180 as a multiphase analysis. Yellow 1050, teal Late Middle Ages and grey later elements excluded. Missing segments are not reconstructed.
pierre.method: Similarity fit to the surviving church's west facade midpoint and eastern main apse end on IGN Plan v2. Two withheld nave corners; manual low-resolution annotations limit accuracy.
